subject.title: [Bug]: plugin temp-dir tests fail on any host where /tmp/openclaw is preferable (env-coupled os.tmpdir assertions)

question: Should maintainers narrow this issue to the git-install temp-root assertion fixed by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101884 and split the two other reported plugin test failures into separate tracked work?
rationale: The code evidence shows one real temp-root assertion bug plus two separate source-level failures, and the protected `maintainer` label blocks ClawSweeper from closing or queueing automated repair without explicit maintainer handling.

options.title: Narrow and split follow-ups
options.body: Land or review the focused git-install PR, then track the manifest metadata and optional-tools failures as separate issues with their own root causes.

options.title: Keep one broad tracker
options.body: Leave this issue as the umbrella for all three failures and require maintainers to coordinate multiple independent fixes under one report.

options.title: Batch into one manual fix
options.body: Ask a maintainer-owned branch to fix all three test failures together before closing the report.

recommendation.title: Narrow and split follow-ups
recommendation.body: Land or review the focused git-install PR, then track the manifest metadata and optional-tools failures as separate issues with their own root causes.

likelyOwner.reason: He reported the repro, is tied to the temp-root change history, and is best positioned to decide whether to split or keep the protected maintainer-labeled tracker broad.
